findings.title: Retained questions lose corresponding replacement gold
findings.fix: Define merge/replacement modes and reconcile questions/gold consistently.
findings.validation: Shrinking/expanding/filtered/public-only reimports preserve declared annotation invariants.
findings.limit: Changed-source imports; no blanket assumption omitted histories should delete.

findings.title: Manual exported history collides on reimport
findings.fix: Reconcile preserved manual IDs idempotently; reject different-content conflicts explicitly.
findings.validation: Export to supported dataset directory, reimport twice, then original reimport.
findings.limit: Probe includes required questions file; export fragment alone is not the tested input.

findings.title: Missing turn ID imports then crashes indexing
findings.fix: Validate schemas, unique typed IDs, and history linkage or explicitly generate stable IDs.
findings.validation: Missing/duplicate/empty IDs and orphan questions fail consistently before index use.
findings.limit: Missing-ID crash measured; duplicate-ID and orphan-question downstream errors not measured.

findings.title: Failed import leaves pending question insert later committed implicitly
findings.fix: Own question-file transaction/savepoint and rollback on failure; initialize schema outside operational transactions.
findings.validation: After late malformed question, Memory initialization or unrelated operations must not publish failed inserts.
findings.limit: Per-history checkpoints may remain intentional; delayed implicit commit is the defect.

findings.title: Unknown colon labels are prior-speaker continuation text
findings.fix: Expose likely unknown labels for explicit correction/acceptance; document multiline grammar.
findings.validation: Unknown roles, known aliases, quoted transcripts and ordinary colon notes remain distinguishable.
findings.limit: Not every colon line is a speaker; current behavior can be intentional.

findings.title: Invalid direct Config values exceed chunk cap or fail late
findings.fix: Validate configuration relationships and clamp fallback chunk end.
findings.validation: Invalid values reject at construction; default and boundary-valid configurations obey real-tokenizer caps.
findings.limit: Not triggered by application defaults; UI exposure not established.

findings.title: Atomic JSON writers share one temporary filename
findings.fix: Use invocation-unique same-directory temp files plus caller locks for read-modify-write.
findings.validation: Overlapping writers do not remove one another's temp files or raise replace FileNotFoundError.
findings.limit: Unprotected concurrent production caller to same path not established by ING.

findings.title: Two index builds collide inserting ready marker
findings.fix: Serialize per-content builds or recheck readiness within idempotent transaction publication.
findings.validation: Separate-connection/process synchronized lexical/dense builds complete with one intact index.
findings.limit: Barrier establishes possible race, not observed production frequency.

findings.title: Config identity rereads changed lock while Models keeps old snapshot
findings.fix: Use one immutable revision snapshot across runtime or reject changed lock until restart.
findings.validation: Temporary lock mutation preserves one consistent identity or errors clearly.
findings.limit: Requires live lock change; stable-lock documented workflows avoid it.

findings.title: MPS allocation/load exceptions bypass forward-only CPU fallback
findings.fix: Centralize recoverable load/forward retry policy or narrow documented promise.
findings.validation: Mock load/forward failure retries CPU once with clean state; optional real hardware check separately.
findings.limit: No actual device failure or weights used.

findings.title: Memory records expose mutable cached objects
findings.fix: Return immutable records/copies or explicitly document read-only ownership.
findings.validation: External mutation cannot silently change later records; benchmark copy cost.
findings.limit: Existing inspected callers do not mutate records.

findings.title: Unknown explicit history selection silently builds nothing
findings.fix: Report missing requested IDs unless allow-missing is explicit.
findings.validation: Mixed valid/missing IDs, empty selection and missing split have deliberate behavior.
findings.limit: Zero-work selection may sometimes be intentional.

findings.title: Lexical candidates load unused embedding BLOBs
findings.fix: Remove embedding join/vector column from lexical query path.
findings.validation: Equivalent lexical results; controlled bytes/RSS/cold-warm timings.
findings.limit: No production latency/RSS benefit measured.

findings.title: Index trusts custom or stored vector validity
findings.fix: Validate custom adapter/storage dimension and finite contracts when required.
findings.validation: Malformed shapes/NaNs/truncated BLOBs fail before ranking.
findings.limit: Custom fake bypasses actual Models.embed finite guard; no corrupt production vectors observed.

findings.title: Cue regexes do not model negation or revocation
findings.fix: Keep hints separate from assertion/state proof; evaluate downstream gating in RET.
findings.validation: Contrastive negation/conditional/revocation/entity examples scored on downstream consequences.
findings.limit: Lexical hints explicitly are not verified state; not standalone semantic bug.

findings.title: Period-space sentence ends fail exact offset boundary matching
findings.fix: Align punctuation ends to token ends while preserving source spans; bump memory scheme.
findings.validation: Real-tokenizer punctuation/newline/Unicode boundary tests and retention checks.
findings.limit: Six-sentence synthetic real-tokenizer example; downstream accuracy prevalence unmeasured.

findings.title: Duplicate archive basenames overwrite per-history content; empty archive succeeds
findings.fix: Validate recognized file identity and define explicit partial/merge semantics; reject ambiguous duplicates.
findings.validation: Wrapped/partial/empty/duplicate/multi-split archives behave explicitly.
findings.limit: Histories-only partial archives intentionally used by existing tests; do not require both files universally.

findings.title: Same-batch identical fresh texts are embedded repeatedly
findings.fix: Encode unique text hashes per fresh batch then fan out to distinct chunk IDs.
findings.validation: Repeated/unique chunks and later append reuse preserve output equality and reduce submitted text count.
findings.limit: Six submitted texts versus three unique measured with fake vectors; real inference speed unmeasured.

findings.title: Replaced content revisions remain stored without retention accounting
findings.fix: Add reference-aware dry-run retention accounting/garbage collection policy if storage warrants it.
findings.validation: Shared content, saved provenance, cache references and interrupted cleanup remain intact.
findings.limit: Retention may be intentional immutable audit/cache; no disk exhaustion or leak claim.

findings.title: Public customer/call/product identity metadata discarded during ingestion
findings.fix: Version schema/import and preserve validated public session metadata separately from evaluation annotations; bind to split/history/session and expose IDs to aggregation/export.
findings.validation: Round-trip176 calls/four fields; group147 customers including29 multi-call identities; latest eligible call/as-of/product-scope checks; verify no gold outcome/reason labels ingested.
findings.limit: Public-only probe; identity inference from text not logically impossible but not equivalent to supplied IDs; call gold remains evaluation-only; complements RET-05.
